description: The duplicate record owns both its copy of the genuinely duplicated invoice (INV-8100) and a unique legitimate open invoice (INV-8200) that must move to the canonical customer still open, not voided.

incident.summary: Counterfactual: the duplicate Ada Byron record has real billing history of its own alongside the duplicated invoice.

task.objective: Resolve duplicate customer records: merge each duplicate pair into its canonical record, void only genuinely duplicated invoices, transfer legitimate history, and leave an accurate audit trail.
constraints: Never delete a row; duplicates are deactivated, not removed
Void only genuinely duplicated invoice copies; voided rows stay where they were
Move the duplicate's tickets and remaining active invoices to the canonical customer
Write one customer.dedup.merge audit event per deactivated duplicate
Unrelated customers and their rows must not change
